title: Ostrich Ki Sabse Badi Aankhein! 🐦 #shorts
idea: Mind-blowing facts about the common ostrich including its huge 50mm eyes, 70 km/h speed, and 225 kgf kick.

lines.text: Kya aapko pata hai zameen par sabse badi aankhon wala jaanwar kaun sa hai?
Yeh hai Ostrich, jiski aankhein 50 millimeter tak choti ball jitni badi hoti hain!
Yeh anokha pakshi 70 km/h ki tez speed se bhaag sakta hai!
Iska ek anda aam murgi ke ande se 20 guna zyada bhari hai!
Iska 225 kgf wala ek kick ek sher ko bhi dher kar sakta hai!
Kya aapne kabhi real life mein Ostrich dekha hai? Comment mein batao!

facts.claim: Ostrich eyes are 50 mm in diameter, the largest of any land vertebrate.
An ostrich egg weighs over 20 times a chicken egg.
An ostrich kick can yield 225 kgf.
